name: Riftmaster Naqri

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: The hall, bask in its magnificence— shh! That's Valinna!
dialogue.trigger: Riftmaster Naqri is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.line: <He heads over to listen.>
dialogue.trigger: Riftmaster Naqri is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.speaker: Valinna
dialogue.line: I need that staff. Lock the gates, Riftmaster. No one leaves until I find it.
dialogue.trigger: Riftmaster Naqri is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: No one has ever challenged me and lived, Magnastylus.
dialogue.trigger: Riftmaster Naqri is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: She has them calling her Magnastylus? No matter, the staff remains hidden. Our efforts may yet be successful.
dialogue.trigger: Riftmaster Naqri is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.line: <Valinna and Naqri move on.>
dialogue.trigger: Riftmaster Naqri is first encountered once you enter the Halls proper, Keshargo will ask you to take a look around before he notices Valinna and Riftmaster Naqri in conversation

dialogue.speaker: Valinna
dialogue.line: I must consult the web of truth. Alert me with any news of the staff or the old fool.
dialogue.trigger: Following Keshargo, you soon arrive in a vast library where Valinna will be giving orders to the Riftmaster

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: No need to involve you, Magnastylus. I'll beat anyone who tries to get through here.
dialogue.trigger: Following Keshargo, you soon arrive in a vast library where Valinna will be giving orders to the Riftmaster

dialogue.line: <Valinna goes through door and Riftmaster Naqri stalks to the middle of the room.>
dialogue.trigger: Following Keshargo, you soon arrive in a vast library where Valinna will be giving orders to the Riftmaster

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: Naqri guards the rifts due to his more … aggressive nature. There'll be no reasoning with him.
dialogue.trigger: Following Keshargo, you soon arrive in a vast library where Valinna will be giving orders to the Riftmaster

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: I'll defeat you under the Golden Eye's watch.
dialogue.trigger: When you begin your fight with him, Riftmaster Naqri will say one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: Foolish heroes to follow an old fool. How fitting.
dialogue.trigger: When you begin your fight with him, Riftmaster Naqri will say one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: Been too long since I faced enemies on this side of the gate.
dialogue.trigger: When you begin your fight with him, Riftmaster Naqri will say one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: You want to visit Oblivion? Come closer, I'll let you see it without the rifts.
dialogue.trigger: When you begin your fight with him, Riftmaster Naqri will say one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: Let's test your mettle.
dialogue.trigger: When combat begins

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: I'm faster than you.
dialogue.trigger: When combat begins

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: I'll defeat you with the works of the scribes.
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: Knowledge, give me versatility.
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: Knowledge, give me reserves.
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: Knowledge, give me power.
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: Knowledge, give me strength.
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: I command the realms of knowledge!
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: Stay still. Let me put a book through your skull.
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: I'll fill books with your blood.
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: I'll batter your bones with hardcovers.
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: I've held the horrors at bay. You are nothing.
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.line: more lines
dialogue.trigger: During combat

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: You should've done your research before challenging me.
dialogue.trigger: When the group is wiped

dialogue.speaker: Riftmaster Naqri
dialogue.line: You can't get past me.
dialogue.trigger: Once you have slain Riftmaster Naqri, Keshargo will make a comment before heading to the Deadlands Pathway door

dialogue.line: <Riftmaster Naqri dies.>
dialogue.trigger: Once you have slain Riftmaster Naqri, Keshargo will make a comment before heading to the Deadlands Pathway door

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: Naqri always was too arrogant.
dialogue.trigger: Once you have slain Riftmaster Naqri, Keshargo will make a comment before heading to the Deadlands Pathway door

dialogue.line: <He runs to the door and goes through.>
dialogue.trigger: Once you have slain Riftmaster Naqri, Keshargo will make a comment before heading to the Deadlands Pathway door

dialogue.speaker: Keshargo
dialogue.line: Web of truth? What could Valinna mean? No matter, we must retrieve the Itinerant Staff.
dialogue.trigger: Once you have slain Riftmaster Naqri, Keshargo will make a comment before heading to the Deadlands Pathway door

notes: Sigils used by Riftmaster Naqri are identical in appearance to Symbols of Xarxes used by Archivist Ernarde. They differ in colors and effects, however.
related_quests: A War of Scribes: A usurper has taken control of the Scribes of Mora.
Pledge: Scrivener's Hall: Explore Scrivener's Hall and return Undaunted.
summary: Riftmaster Naqri is an Imperial member of the Scribes of Mora who has sided with Valinna in her takeover of the organization. He is the first boss of Scrivener's Hall.
